:::{#def-shape-rule}
#### Shape rule

The **shape rule** of [matrix multiplication](#def-matrix-mult)
says that an $m \times k$ [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) times a $k \times n$ matrix is an $m \times n$ matrix,
and that the multiplication is defined only when the inner pair of sizes matches:

$$(m \times k)(k \times n) \;\longrightarrow\; m \times n$$ {#eq-shape-rule}

:::
